subject: A checking bonus for growing businesses
body: New to Northbeam? Earn a $300 bonus with Business Essentials Checking. To qualify, deposit $5,000 in new money within 30 days of opening and maintain that balance for 60 days. Avoid the $15 monthly fee with a $2,500 minimum daily balance. Bonus terms apply: northbeam.example/offers. Fees may apply; see fee schedule. Deposits insured up to applicable limits.

Northbeam Business Rewards Card: earn a $500 statement credit after you spend $6,000 in purchases within the first 3 months. Annual fee is $0 the first year, then $95. Subject to credit approval. Bonus terms apply: northbeam.example/offers. Fees may apply; see fee schedule.

Northbeam: Earn a $500 statement credit on the Business Rewards Card after $6,000 in purchases in 3 months. Subject to credit approval. Bonus terms apply: northbeam.example/offers. Reply STOP to opt out.

subject: Earn $150 with Business Growth Savings
body: Deposit $25,000 in new money within 15 days, maintain it for 90 days, and earn a $150 bonus with Business Growth Savings. Avoid the $10 monthly fee with a $5,000 minimum daily balance. Bonus terms apply: northbeam.example/offers. Fees may apply; see fee schedule. Deposits insured up to applicable limits. Rates are variable and may change.

subject: Get $400 for opening business checking
body: Open Business Essentials Checking, deposit $5,000 in new money within 30 days, and keep that balance for 60 days, and receive a $400 bonus. Bonus terms apply: northbeam.example/offers. Fees may apply; see fee schedule. Deposits insured up to applicable limits.
